subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Fly Air China into Chongqing and out of Chongqing again, with 4★ hotels in Chongqing, Dujiangyan and Chengdu. You see Ciqikou Ancient Town, the Liziba light rail through apartment blocks, Guanxian Ancient City and Chengdu’s Chunxi Road, with an English-speaking guide on a private coach.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 29–Dec 3 2026 to Dec 6–10 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Chongqing
items: Fly Manila – Chongqing (Nov/Dec: 02:25 – 06:20; other dates 01:50 – 05:40); meet the guide at the airport
Liziba Station, to see light rail running through residential buildings (2 stations)
People’s Great Hall of Chongqing (outside view)
Transfer to the hotel and check in
Optional: dinner at the world’s largest hot pot restaurant, Pipa Yuan

itinerary.title: Chongqing
items: Bayi Food Street (food on your own)
Kuixing Tower, which feels like the 1st floor but is on the 22nd
Optional: night view of Hongya Cave and Two Rivers Cruise

itinerary.title: Chongqing – Dujiangyan
items: Selfie-taking Panda Statue at Yangtianwo Square
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Dujiangyan – Chengdu
items: Chinese medicine shop and silk store
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Chengdu – Chongqing – Manila
items: Transfer to Chongqing, then to the airport
Fly Chongqing – Manila (Nov/Dec: 21:30 – 01:20 next day; other dates 20:50 – 00:50 next day)

placeDesc.Ciqikou Ancient Town: A restored riverside old town in Chongqing with stone-paved lanes and snack shops.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing light-rail station where the train runs through a residential building.
placeDesc.People’s Great Hall of Chongqing: A domed hall in Chongqing modelled on the Temple of Heaven, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Shibati: A historic Chongqing district of old stone stairs and lanes, also known as Eighteen Stairs.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: The central shopping square of Chongqing, around a landmark monument.
placeDesc.Bayi Food Street: A street of local Chongqing food stalls, where meals are on your own.
placeDesc.Guotai Art Center: A cultural complex in Chongqing with an unusual building design, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Kuixing Tower: A Chongqing building where the entrance at street level is on the 22nd floor.
placeDesc.Chaotianmen Square: A riverside square at the point where the Yangtze and Jialing rivers meet.
placeDesc.Guanxian Ancient City: The old town of Dujiangyan, with traditional streets and buildings.
placeDesc.Zhongshuge Bookstore: A well-known bookstore chain with striking mirrored interior design.
placeDesc.Chunxi Road: A major pedestrian shopping street in central Chengdu.
placeDesc.IFS Plaza: A large shopping mall in Chengdu with a giant panda sculpture climbing its facade.
placeDesc.Sino-Ocean Taikoo Li: An open-air shopping and dining district in Chengdu built around old temples.
